  | derive hs | split hs | transfer hs | depend hs | enter hs | read hs | write hs
  | writeShared hs | pin hs | unpin hs | endUse hs | free hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; rfl

/-- A kernel step keeps the existing authorities, and activates none of them (MM-03.3 §3–5). -/
theorem KStep.active_back {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') :
    s.A.length ≤ s'.A.length ∧ ∀ x, x < s.A.length → s'.Active x → s.Active x := by
  have append : ∀ (l : List Authority), s.A.length ≤ (s.A ++ l).length ∧
      ∀ x, x < s.A.length → ({ s with A := s.A ++ l } : S3).Active x → s.Active x :=
    fun l => ⟨by simp, fun x hx ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ => ⟨y, by
      rw [show ({ s with A := s.A ++ l } : S3).A = s.A ++ l from rfl,
        List.getElem?_append_left hx] at hy; exact hy, ya⟩⟩
  have rel : ∀ s₁ : S3, OnlyReleases s s₁ →
      s.A.length ≤ s₁.A.length ∧ ∀ x, x < s.A.length → s₁.Active x → s.Active x :=
    fun s₁ hr => ⟨Nat.le_of_eq hr.1.symm, fun x _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ => by
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, -, -, -, a⟩ := hr.2 x y hy; exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, a ya⟩⟩
  have same : ∀ s₁ : S3, s₁.A = s.A →
      s.A.length ≤ s₁.A.length ∧ ∀ x, x < s.A.length → s₁.Active x → s.Active x :=
    fun s₁ hA => ⟨by rw [hA]; exact Nat.le_refl _, fun x _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ => ⟨y, by rw [hA] at hy; exact hy, ya⟩⟩
  cases h with
  | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact append _
  | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact append _
  | release hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact rel _ (release_releases s _)
  | transfer hs =>
    rename_i src dst
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun x _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ => ?_⟩
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, by split at ya <;> exact ya⟩
  | depend hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl
  | read hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl
  | write hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl
  | writeShared hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl
  | pin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl
  | unpin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl
  | enter hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    refine ⟨by simp [enterEff, length_mapI], fun x hx ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ => ?_⟩
    rw [enter_lt hx] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, by split at ya <;> exact ya⟩
  | exit hs =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold ExitPre at hpre
    split at hpre
    · rename_i f F₀ hF
      refine ⟨by rw [exitEff_eq hF]; simp [length_mapI], fun x _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ => ?_⟩
      rw [exit_A_get hF] at hy
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
      exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, exitG_active' hy₀ ya⟩
    · exact hpre.elim
  | endUse hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact rel _ ((endUseS_releases s _).trans cleanup_releases)
  | free hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact rel _ ((freeS_releases s _).trans cleanup_releases)
  | alloc hs => cases hs; exact append _
  | store hs =>
    rename_i a p
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    have sk := store_skel s a p
    exact ⟨Nat.le_of_eq sk.1.symm, fun x _ h => sk.active.1 h⟩

/-- A kernel step preserves the arena invariants of the state (D3): the entries do not change, a
live entry was live before, and `arena_inv_preserved` carries its invariant over. -/
theorem kstep_preserves_arenas {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (hw : ArenasWF s) (hai : ArenasInv s) (h : KStep k s s') : ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hact⟩ := h.active_back
  refine ⟨fun ar har => ?_, fun ar har ha => ?_⟩
  · rw [h.arenas] at har; exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hw ar har) hlen
  · rw [h.arenas] at har
    exact arena_inv_preserved hwf hinv (hai ar har (hact _ (hw ar har) ha)) h ha

/-- `newArena` preserves `WF3`, `Inv3` and the arena invariants (D3; F1): it only adds an entry,
which satisfies `ArenaInv` by its preconditions. -/
theorem newArena_preserves {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (hw : ArenasWF s) (hai : ArenasInv s) (h : NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s')) :
    WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hu, hint, -, h1, h2, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[i]? = some y := by
    unfold OptP at hint; split at hint
    · exact ⟨_, ‹_›⟩
    · exact hint.elim
  rw [hy] at hint; obtain ⟨-, hm, hpl⟩ := hint
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, y.holder = .place v := by
    cases hh : y.holder with
    | place v => exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
    | frame f => rw [hh] at hpl; cases hpl
  refine ⟨hwf.arenas _, hinv.arenas _, fun ar har => ?_, fun ar har ha => ?_⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 har with har | har
    · exact hw ar har
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 har]; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 har with har | har
    · exact (hai ar har ha).arenas _
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 har]
      exact ⟨fun l hl => hl, fun _ he => (by cases he), List.Pairwise.nil, fun _ he => (by cases he),
        fun _ he => (by cases he), hu.lt, ⟨y, v, hy, hm, hv⟩, fun l => ⟨h1 l, h2 l⟩⟩

/-- The arena invariant of another arena carries over to `issue` (D3): `issue` adds an authority
and writes the metadata, and changes no place. -/
theorem arenaInv_issue {s : S3} {ar ar₂ : Arena} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hai : ArenaInv s ar₂) : ArenaInv (issueEff s ar region dst).1 ar₂ := by
  obtain ⟨yi, vi, hyi, -, hhi⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hi := lt_of_getElem? hyi
  exact arenaInv_transport hai (fun j y hy => ⟨y, by
      show (s.addAuth _).A[j]? = _; rw [addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy,
      rfl, rfl, id, id⟩) (Nat.le_refl _)
    (fun y y' v h1 h2 h3 => ⟨v, by
      have h2' : (s.addAuth _).A[ar₂.internal]? = some y' := h2
      rw [addAuth_lt hi, h1] at h2'; cases h2'; exact h3⟩) (fun _ => Iff.rfl)

/-- `arena.issue` on an entry of the state preserves `WF3`, `Inv3` and the arena invariants
(MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3). -/
theorem issueAt_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat}
    (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s) (hw : ArenasWF s) (hai : ArenasInv s)
    (h : IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s')) :
    WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' := by
  cases h with
  | @ok ar s₁ ar₁ har hst =>
  have hst' := hst
  cases hst with
  | ok hp hav hright _ =>
  have hlive : s.Active ar.internal := hp.2.1
  have hmem : ar ∈ s.arenas := List.mem_of_getElem? har
  obtain ⟨hwf₁, hinv₁, hai₁⟩ := arena_issue_preserves_disjointness hwf hinv.base (hai ar hmem hlive) hst'
  have hao := issue_preserves_anchorOrder hinv.ao hst'
  have hnd := issue_preserves_noDangling hinv.nd hst'
  have hlen : (issueEff s ar region dst).1.A.length = s.A.length + 1 := by
    simp [issueEff, S3.addAuth]
  refine ⟨hwf₁.arenas _, (show Inv3 (issueEff s ar region dst).1 from ⟨hinv₁, hao, hnd⟩).arenas _,
    fun ar₂ har₂ => ?_, fun ar₂ har₂ ha => ?_⟩
  · show ar₂.internal < (issueEff s ar region dst).1.A.length
    rw [hlen]
    rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set har₂ with har₂ | rfl
    · have := hw ar₂ har₂; omega
    · have := hw ar hmem; exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt this
  · rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set har₂ with har₂ | rfl
    · have hl := hw ar₂ har₂
      have ha' : s.Active ar₂.internal := by
        obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := ha
        exact ⟨y, by
          have hy' : (s.addAuth _).A[ar₂.internal]? = some y := hy
          rwa [addAuth_lt hl] at hy', ya⟩
      exact (arenaInv_issue (hai ar₂ har₂ ha')).arenas _
    · exact hai₁.arenas _

/-- `arena.reset` on an entry of the state preserves `WF3`, `Inv3` and the arena invariants
(MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): it only writes the metadata and the logical state of the entry. -/
theorem resetAt_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat}
    (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s) (hw : ArenasWF s) (hai : ArenasInv s)
    (h : ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s')) :
    WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  unfold ResetAtPre at hpre
  unfold resetAtEff
  cases har : s.arenas[i]? with
  | none => rw [har] at hpre; exact hpre.elim
  | some ar =>
    rw [har] at hpre; obtain ⟨hlive, hrp⟩ := hpre
    have hmem : ar ∈ s.arenas := List.mem_of_getElem? har
    have hst : ResetStep k ar via s (.ok (resetEff s ar)) := Guarded.ok_iff.2 ⟨hrp, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hwf₁, hinv₁⟩ := arena_reset_preserves_wf hwf hinv.base hst
    obtain ⟨hai₁, -, -⟩ := arena_reset_preserves (hai ar hmem hlive) hst
    have hao := reset_preserves_anchorOrder hinv.ao hst
    have hnd := reset_preserves_noDangling hinv.nd hst
    refine ⟨hwf₁.arenas _, (show Inv3 (resetEff s ar).1 from ⟨hinv₁, hao, hnd⟩).arenas _,
      fun ar₂ har₂ => ?_, fun ar₂ har₂ ha => ?_⟩
    · rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set har₂ with har₂ | rfl
      · exact hw ar₂ har₂
      · exact hw ar hmem
    · rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set har₂ with har₂ | rfl
      · exact hai ar₂ har₂ ha
      · exact hai₁.arenas _

/-- `arena_entry_follows_transfer` (D3; A4; F1): when the arena value, the place that holds
`internal`, is transferred, the entry stays live and satisfies `ArenaInv`, and the destination
becomes its arena value. -/
theorem arena_entry_follows_transfer {k : K} {s s' : S3} {ar : Arena} {v dst : Nat}
    (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) (hai : ArenaInv s ar) (hlive : s.Active ar.internal)
    (hv : arenaValue s ar = some v) (h : TransferStep k v dst s (.ok s')) :
    s'.Active ar.internal ∧ ArenaInv s' ar ∧ arenaValue s' ar = some dst := by
  have hk : KStep k s s' := .transfer h
  obtain ⟨⟨hsrc, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hlive' : (transferEff s v dst).Active ar.internal := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hlive
    refine ⟨if heldIn s.P v y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P v dst y.holder } else y,
      by rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; rfl, ?_⟩
    split <;> exact ya
  refine ⟨hlive', arena_inv_preserved hwf hinv hai hk hlive', ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hhv⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ y.holder = .place v := by
    unfold arenaValue at hv
    cases hy : s.A[ar.internal]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at hv; cases hv
    | some y =>
      rw [hy] at hv; simp only at hv
      split at hv
      · rename_i w hw; cases hv; exact ⟨y, rfl, hw⟩
      · cases hv
  have hh : heldIn s.P v y.holder := by rw [hhv]; exact ⟨hsrc.lt, .inl rfl⟩
  unfold arenaValue
  rw [transfer_A_get, hy]
  have hh' : heldIn s.P v (.place v) := by rw [← hhv]; exact hh
  simp [hhv, mvTo, corr_src, hh']

/-- `arena_dies_with_internal` (D3; A6; F1): after `endUse` of the arena value, the place that
holds `internal`, `internal` is released: the entry is no longer live. -/
theorem arena_dies_with_internal {k : K} {s s' : S3} {ar : Arena} {v : Nat}
    (hv : arenaValue s ar = some v) (h : EndUseStep k v s (.ok s')) :
    ¬ s'.Active ar.internal := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hu, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  rintro ⟨z, hz, za⟩
  obtain ⟨hz₀, hnh, -⟩ := endUse_active hz za
  apply hnh
  unfold arenaValue at hv
  rw [hz₀] at hv; simp only at hv
  split at hv
  · rename_i w hw; cases hv; rw [hw]; exact ⟨hu.lt, .inl rfl⟩
  · cases hv

/-! ## Outcomes and guarded relations (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- `Outcome3` (MM-03.3 §3): `ok` with the new state, or `reject`, refusal by the static
discipline, distinct from a defined failure of an abstraction and from `ub` of MM-02. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject

/-- Common form of the transition rules of MM-03.3 §3–5: `ok` with the effect when the
precondition holds, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

/-! ## O1 `derive` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, place, mode)` (MM-03.3 §3, O1): a new active authority with
origin `src`, footprint `footprint place`, mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- O1.4 (MM-03.3 §3): every existing authority stays compatible with the derived one in the
resulting state. Not a precondition of `derive`: it follows from O1.1 and O1.3 under I1
(`derive_compat_redundant`, A11). -/
def DeriveCompat (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q,
    OptP (effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p) (fun e => Compat e m) True

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1), in order: 1 active origin, exercisable at the
requested mode (B2);
place still usable (MM-03.3.1); 2 requested footprint within the origin's; 3 mode permitted by
the effective authority of the origin on each leaf. O1.4 is removed (A11): it follows from the
others under I1 (`derive_compat_redundant`). O1.5 is not restated: `derive` deactivates
nothing. -/
def DerivePre (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ s.Usable q ∧
  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, p ∈ s.afp src) ∧
  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m)

instance (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (DerivePre s src q m) := by
  unfold DerivePre; infer_instance

/-- `derive` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O1). -/
def DeriveStep (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src q m) (deriveEff s src q m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (MM-03.3 §3, O2): one derived `Modify` authority per
region, held by the current frame; the origin remains a logical authority. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p`: an active descendant of `src` in
mode `Modify` covering `p` (MM-03.3 §3, O2.4). -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2), in order: 1 the origin is an active authority,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), with effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions; 2 regions within the available footprint
(the origin's footprint where its effective authority is present); 3 regions pairwise disjoint,
structurally (no shared leaf) or by `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8); 4 no region covers an
exclusive right already distributed. O2.5 is not restated: `split` changes neither `D` nor
activity. -/
def SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
  rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) := by
  unfold SplitPre; infer_instance

/-- `split` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (MM-03.3 §3, A6) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A6: end of a temporary access): the
authority becomes inactive. F4: an authority held by a place `q` leaves the anchors of `q` in the
same transition. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (C4): the holder is the current frame, or a place on
which the current frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HasRight`, B2). -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor, except the place that holds `a`, whose anchor
`a` is removed by the release (F4); C4: the authority is derived, an authority
without origin is rejected, and its holder is the current frame or a place on which the current
frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HolderRight`). O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions) is
not represented in the kernel. -/
def ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active a ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q → (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)) ∧
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none ∧ HolderRight s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance

/-- `release` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, A4, A5) -/
/-! ## F4 `store` -/

/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
operation exists (F4). -/
def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
    True) ∧
  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance

/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Effective authority (MM-03.3.5) -/

/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (MM-03.3.5). -/
def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
    match s.A[j]? with
    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
    | none => none

/-- Cases 1 to 3 of MM-03.3.5 for an active authority covering the leaf, of mode `m`, whose
active covering descendants have modes `ds`. -/
def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe

/-- `effective(a, p)` (MM-03.3.5), computed per leaf, with no stored status: absent if `a` is
inactive or does not cover `p`, `effOf` otherwise. -/
def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
  | none => none

/-- Compatibility of effective modes for ordinary accesses (MM-03.3 §2, I1): only
`Observe`/`Observe` is compatible. -/
def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded
(MM-03.3 §3, O1.3). -/
def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a`, empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Appends an authority to `A`: its identity is `s.A.length`. -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (MM-03.3.6: a containing value
inherits the dependencies of the contained values). -/
def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Dependencies still valid for the values containing leaf `p` (MM-03.3 §5): every anchor of a
place of which `p` is a part is active. -/
def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- Non-escape restriction (MM-03.3.6) for anchor `x` and a destination of frame `fd`: if `x`
is a local anchor (no origin), its frame is `fd` or an ancestor of it, so `fd` does not outlive
it. The frame of an anchor is the frame of its holder (A4, A5). -/
def NoEscape (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.origin = none →
    OptP (s.hframe y.holder) (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) True) True) True

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (NoEscape s x fd) := by
  unfold NoEscape; infer_instance

/-- C1: the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is `fd`, the frame of the dependent,
or one of its ancestors (MM-03.3.1, `ancestor`). The frame of an authority is the frame of its
holder (A4, A5). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` extended to held authorities (G4): for every usable place `q` and every active
authority held by `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of that authority is the frame of `q` or
one of its ancestors (`EffAnchorOK`, C1). -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A`: decidable form. -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index, counted from `i`. -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

theorem length_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α), (mapI f i l).length = l.length
  | _, [] => rfl
  | i, _ :: l => by simp [mapI, length_mapI f (i + 1) l]

theorem getElem?_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α) (j : Nat), (mapI f i l)[j]? = (l[j]?).map (f (i + j))
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | i, a :: l, 0 => by simp [mapI]
  | i, a :: l, j + 1 => by
    simp only [mapI, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_mapI f (i + 1) l j]
    congr 2; omega

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (A2, B2) -/

/-- `s.ExercisableAt a m` (B2): authority `a` is exercisable at mode `m` when `m` does not exceed its
mode and it is held by the current frame, or held by a place `p` such that an authority
exercisable at mode `m` has an effective mode permitting `m` on the whole footprint of `p`. The
authority is active: the rights of a released authority cannot be exercised (MM-03.3 §3, O3).
Inductive, so no cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m`, read on a Boolean premise. -/
def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
    l.any f = l.any g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
      · simpa using h.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exR at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exR; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]

theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- The current frame has an authority exercisable at mode `m` whose effective mode permits `m` on
every leaf of `q` (B2: an operation requires the mode it requests). -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-! ## `alloc` (B5, C6, C9) -/

/-- Outcomes of `alloc` (B5): `ok`; `fail`, a defined failure of the allocator contract, with the
state unchanged; `reject` by the static discipline (MM-03.3 §3). -/
inductive AOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3)
  | fail (s : S3)
  | reject

      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw n r (by omega) hr
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf', -, hlr⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
      refine ⟨l, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf', hlP, .inr ?_⟩⟩
      have hrq : q ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) r := by rw [chain_cons hpr hqr]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      rcases hlr with rfl | hlr
      · exact hrq
      · exact chain_trans hlt (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) r hlr q hrq

/-! ## Reachability (MM-03.3 §10) -/

/-- States reached from the initial state with the static storage `statics` (D1) by `ok`
transitions of the kernel operations, of the arena operations `newArena`, `issue` and `reset`
(D3), and of `store` (F4), for fixed contracts `k` (MM-03.3.8). The static storage is well-formed (`ShapeOK`, C6). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} :
      Reachable k statics s → DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → DependStep q x s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → ExitStep k s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → PinStep p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | newArena {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | issue {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'

/-- Invariants of the reached states (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3): `WF3`, `Inv3`, arena entries
naming existing authorities (`ArenasWF`) and `ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8), used by `split`. -/
theorem reachable_invariants {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s := by
  have mk : ∀ {s s' : S3}, KStep k s s' → WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' → AnchorOrder s' → NoDangling s' →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' :=
    fun hk ih h a d => ⟨h.1, ⟨h.2, a, d⟩,
      kstep_preserves_arenas ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hk⟩
  induction h with
  | init hsh =>
    exact ⟨(init_wf statics hsh).1, (init_wf statics hsh).2, fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h,
      fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h⟩
  | derive _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.derive hs) ih (derive_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (derive_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (derive_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | split _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.split hs) ih (split_preserves_underDD hdd ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (split_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (split_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | release _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.release hs) ih (release_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (release_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (release_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | transfer _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.transfer hs) ih (transfer_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (transfer_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (transfer_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | depend _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.depend hs) ih (depend_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (depend_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (depend_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | enter _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.enter hs) ih (enter_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (enter_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (enter_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | exit _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.exit hs) ih (exit_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (exit_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (exit_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | read _ hs ih => rw [read3_preserves hs]; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.write (k := k) hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (write3_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs) (write3_preserves_anchorOrder _ ih.2.1.ao)
      (write3_preserves_noDangling _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.writeShared hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (writeShared_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (write3_preserves_anchorOrder _ ih.2.1.ao) (write3_preserves_noDangling _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | pin _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.pin (k := k) hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (pinEff_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base) (pinEff_preserves_anchorOrder _ _ ih.2.1.ao)
      (pinEff_preserves_noDangling _ _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | unpin _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.unpin hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (pinEff_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base) (pinEff_preserves_anchorOrder _ _ ih.2.1.ao)
      (pinEff_preserves_noDangling _ _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | endUse _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.endUse hs) ih (endUse_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (endUse_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs)
      (endUse_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | free _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.free hs) ih (free_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs) (free_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs)
      (free_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | alloc _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.alloc hs) ih (alloc_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (alloc_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (alloc_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | newArena _ hs ih => exact newArena_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hs
  | issue _ hs ih => exact issueAt_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hs
  | reset _ hs ih => exact resetAt_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hs
  | store _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.store hs) ih (store_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (store_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (store_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)

/-- `reachable_access_invariant` (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3): every reached state satisfies `WF3`,
`Inv3`, and `ArenaInv` for every live arena. Conditional on the obligation `DDSound k` of
`DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8), used by `split`. -/
theorem reachable_access_invariant_underDD {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar :=
  let h' := reachable_invariants hdd h
  ⟨h'.1, h'.2.1, h'.2.2.2⟩

/-- `reachable_no_dangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §10; D3): in every reached state, no active authority
covers a leaf of a place that is not usable. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_no_dangling {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    NoDangling s :=
  (reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h).2.1.nd

/-- `live_arena_storage_usable` (F2): in every reached state, the storage of a live arena is
usable. A corollary of `NoDangling` (C2): `internal` is active and covers the footprint of the
storage (`ArenaInv`, F1), which has a leaf. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem live_arena_storage_usable {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → s.Usable ar.storage := by
  obtain ⟨hwf, hinv, hai⟩ := reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h
  intro ar har ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
  have hi := hai ar har ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hwf (s.P.length + 1) ar.storage (by omega)
    hi.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := by
    have := (hi.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 l).2 hl
    simpa [S3.afp, hy] using this
  exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => hinv.nd ar.internal y hy ya ar.storage hu l hl hly

/-- `RootLive` on the reached states (G3; auxiliary invariant): every usable root place keeps an
active root authority held by its owner. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_rootLive {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : RootLive s := by
  induction h with
  | init _ => exact init_rootLive _
  | derive _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | split _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | release _ hs ih => exact release_rootLive ih hs
  | transfer hr hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact transfer_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 hpre.1 ih
  | depend _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | enter hr hs ih => exact enter_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | exit _ hs ih => exact exit_rootLive ih hs
  | read _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | pin _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | unpin _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | endUse _ hs ih => exact endUse_rootLive ih hs
  | free _ hs ih => exact free_rootLive ih hs
  | alloc hr hs ih => exact alloc_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | newArena _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | issue _ hs ih =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      cases hst with
      | ok => exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | reset _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split
    · exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
    · exact ih
  | store _ hs ih => exact store_rootLive ih hs

/-- `reachable_no_orphan` (G3): in every reached state, every active authority held by a place is
linked to a frame of the stack by a finite chain of holders without repetition (`NoOrphan`).
Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_no_orphan {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : NoOrphan s :=
  noOrphan_of_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd h).1 (reachable_rootLive hdd h)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` on the reached states (G4): for every usable place and every active authority
it holds, the frame of the effective anchor is the frame of the place or one of its ancestors.
`transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` and the exit check it in their arrival state; the other
operations preserve it. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : AnchorOrderHeld s := by
  induction h with
  | init _ =>
    intro q hq x y hx _ hh
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := init_get hx
    exact effAnchorOK_root_held hx rfl hh hq
  | derive _ hs ih => exact derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | split _ hs ih => exact split_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | release _ hs ih => exact release_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | transfer _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  | depend _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | enter _ hs ih => obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2
  | exit _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold ExitPre at hpre; split at hpre
    · exact hpre.2.2.2.2
    · exact hpre.elim
  | read _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | pin _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | unpin _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | endUse _ hs ih => exact endUse_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | free _ hs ih => exact free_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | alloc hr hs ih => exact alloc_preserves_anchorOrderHeld (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | newArena _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | issue _ hs ih =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      cases hst with
      | ok _ _ _ h4 => exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld h4 rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | reset _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split
    · exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
    · exact ih
  | store _ hs ih => obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2

/-- The invariant of the reached states extended by G3 and G4 (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3, G3, G4):
`WF3`, `Inv3`, `AnchorOrder` extended to held authorities (`AnchorOrderHeld`), `NoOrphan`, and
`ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_access_invariant_ext {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s ∧
      ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar :=
  let h' := reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h
  ⟨h'.1, h'.2.1, reachable_anchorOrderHeld hdd h, reachable_no_orphan hdd h, h'.2.2⟩

/-! ## Initialisation only by writes (J1) -/

/-- One step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10; D3; F4): a kernel step or an arena step. -/
inductive Step (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' → Step k s s'
  | newArena {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | issue {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} :
      IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} : ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Step k s s'

/-- J1: the step from `s` to `s'` writes the leaf `l`: a `write3` or a `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, a `store` into `l`, an `issue` to `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a leaf of the
destination corresponding to a leaf of the source `Init` before the step. -/
def WrittenBy (k : K) (s s' : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ a ls, Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a ls, WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a, StoreStep a l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ i via region, IssueAt k i via region l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ src dst l', TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
    l' ∈ footprint s.P src ∧ corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init)

/-- `init_only_by_writes` (J1): in every `ok` step, a leaf that is not `Init` before and is
`Init` after is written by the step (`WrittenBy`). -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Step k s s') {l : Nat}
    (hl : s.I l ≠ .init) (hl' : s'.I l = .init) : WrittenBy k s s' l := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk =>
    cases hk with
    | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | release hs =>
      rename_i a
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs

entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Kernel state with the pool entries (material §4), the next fresh pool identity ("jamais
réutilisée pendant l'exécution") and the ghost record of resolutions. -/
structure PS where
  s : S3
  pools : List Pool
  nId : Nat
  res : List Res

/-- Outcomes of a pool operation (material §4: `ok | fail | reject`): `fail` is a defined failure
that leaves the state unchanged, as for `alloc` and `issue` (MM-03.3 §3.1). -/
inductive POutcome where
  | ok (ps : PS)
  | fail (ps : PS)
  | reject

/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse the metadata right
and the arena invariant of MM-03.3 §6 (`MetaRight`, `ArenaInv`). -/
def Pool.asArena (pl : Pool) : Arena := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩

/-- Right to update the pool value (material §4, `allocSlot` and `freeSlot`: "`Modify` exerçable
ou `writeShared` sur métadonnées `SharedMutable`"): the metadata right of the arena (MM-03.3 §6,
`MetaRight`), read on the holder of `internal`. -/
def PoolRight (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) : Prop := MetaRight k s pl.asArena via

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (PoolRight k s pl via) := by
  unfold PoolRight; infer_instance

/-- Place of slot `i` (0 if the slot does not exist). -/
def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0

/-- The pool with its slot `i` replaced. -/
def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }

/-- The extended state with its pool `j` replaced. -/
def setPool (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) : PS := { ps with pools := ps.pools.set j pl }

/-! ## `newPool storage internal` (material §4) -/

/-- Preconditions of `newPool storage internal` (material §4: "préconditions de `newArena` (F1, F2,
J1)"): those of `newArena` (MM-03.3 §6, O17), read literally, so clause 4 speaks of the arenas of
the state. -/
def NewPoolPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop := NewArenaPre s storage internal

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewPoolPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewPoolPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newPool storage internal` (material §4): a pool with a fresh identity, one free
entry of generation 0 per child of the storage (the entries are the parts of `storage`, report (f)),
and the kernel state unchanged. -/
def newPoolEff (ps : PS) (storage internal : Nat) : PS :=
  { ps with
    pools := ps.pools ++ [⟨ps.nId, storage, internal,
      (kids ps.s.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
    nId := ps.nId + 1 }

/-- `newPool storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (material §4). -/
def NewPoolStep (storage internal : Nat) (ps : PS) : Outcome3 PS → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewPoolPre ps.s storage internal) (newPoolEff ps storage internal)

/-! ## `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4) -/

/-- First free entry of a list of slots, counted from `i`. -/
def firstFreeF : Nat → List Slot → Option Nat
  | _, [] => none
  | i, sl :: l => if sl.live then firstFreeF (i + 1) l else some i

/-- First free entry of a pool (report (f): the material does not say which free entry). -/
def firstFree (pl : Pool) : Option Nat := firstFreeF 0 pl.slots

/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4): the right to update the pool value;
`dst` a usable leaf, not `Init`, holding no active authority, under exercisable `Modify`. The size
of a handle is not represented: MM-03 has no sizes (report (f)). -/
def AllocSlotStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  PoolRight k s pl via ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
      True
......
      ⟨1, 5, 5, [⟨6, 0, true⟩, ⟨7, 0, false⟩]⟩] ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (ob3o ++ [.resolve 1 ⟨1, 0, 0⟩ .modify])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide, run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- Two pools on the same `internal`: the `freeSlot` of pool 1 ends the content of the entry 0 of
pool 0, written and live. -/
def ob3b : List Op := pb ++ [.newPool 4 4, .allocSlot 0 0 2, .allocSlot 1 0 3, .write 4 [5],
  .freeSlot 1 0 ⟨1, 0, 0⟩]

theorem pool_two_freeSlot_cross : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] ob3b) ∧
    (run K0 [] (ob3b.take 9)).s.I 5 = .init ∧ (run K0 [] ob3b).s.I 5 = .uninit ∧
    (run K0 [] ob3b).pools.map (fun pl => pl.slots.map (·.live)) = [[true, false], [false, false]] :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- The mirror: `newArena` on the `internal` of a live pool is accepted (O17.4 reads arenas). -/
theorem arena_on_pool_internal :
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 0 2, .newArena 4 4])) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- "Périmé" read twice (report, (f)): on a fresh pool, `resolveMany` of the handle of a free entry at
its current generation fails (the entry is free), while `freeSlot` of the same handle is accepted
(only the identity and the generation are read). -/
theorem pool_free_entry_handle : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] pb) ∧
    ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .modify (run K0 [] pb) (.fail (run K0 [] pb)) ∧
    (pexec K0 (run K0 [] pb) (.freeSlot 0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isSome = true :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .fail (pl := ⟨0, 4, 4, [⟨5, 0, false⟩, ⟨6, 0, false⟩]⟩) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
    by decide⟩

/-- `allocSlot` leaves the content of the entry as it is (material §4: "son contenu reste
`Uninit`"): a storage written before `newPool` gives a live entry whose content is `Init`. -/
theorem pool_allocSlot_content_init : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf],
      .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)],
      .write 4 [5], .newPool 4 4, .allocSlot 0 0 2]) ∧
    (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
      .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)], .write 4 [5], .newPool 4 4,
      .allocSlot 0 0 2]).s.I 5 = .init :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide⟩

/-! ## J. Out of kernel (material §1 J): the one expressible expansion -/

/-- Contracts with the place 3 deallocable by the authority 7. -/
abbrev KJ : K := KT [] [] [] [3] [(3, 7)]

/-- H42 (`defer free(x)` then `transfer(x)` before an exit) has no `defer` in the kernel; its
straight-line expansion, `transfer` of the value `x` (1) owning the storage 3 into `y` (2), then the
deferred `free` of that storage, runs: the kernel accepts the `free` of the storage now owned by
`y` (report, (a), section J). -/
theorem J_H42_expansion : PReach KJ [] (run KJ [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0],
    .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf], .transfer 1 2, .free 3 7]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

end Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-- State of the library: the kernel state, the stacks (the identity of a stack is its index) and
the next fresh mark identifier. -/
structure DS where
  s : S3
  stacks : List Stack
  fresh : Nat

/-- Outcome of a library operation; `fail` leaves the state unchanged (§58). -/
inductive Out where
  | ok (d : DS)
  | fail
  | reject

/-- The `n` cells of the stack from the index `b`. -/
def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n

/-- The cells above the mark `m`, from its top to the current top: those that `rewind m` returns
to the available part (brief: "les régions au-dessus de `m`"). A region issued after `m` and still
below the top lies there, but not every such region does: a block grown after `m` from a base below
`m` starts below it, and a region issued after `m` and returned by an intermediate `rewind` lies
above the current top (`case_rewind_reading`; report, (f)). -/
def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)

/-- The stack seen as an administration of its storage, for `MetaRightM` and `blockOf`. -/
def Stack.arena (st : Stack) : Arena := ⟨st.storage, st.internal, [], []⟩

/-- No active authority is held by the destination (O8.2, §77.2). -/
def NoHeld (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True

instance (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoHeld s dst) := by unfold NoHeld; infer_instance

/-- Static preconditions of `push` of the cells `r`, checked before the room (§58, §77.4), those of
the restricted `issue` (`IssueStaticR`, §77.1 and §77.2): the stack is live, the current frame has
exercisable `Modify` on the stack value (`MetaRightM`), and the destination is a usable leaf under
exercisable `Modify`, not `Init`, holding no active authority and outside `r`. The brief's "`fail`
si pas de place" stands for both the inclusion of the region in the storage (a static clause of
§77.2) and its availability (§77.4): `push` fails when the cells requested go past the storage. -/
def PushStatic (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRightM s st.arena ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoHeld s dst ∧ dst ∉ r

instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (PushStatic s st r dst) := by
  unfold PushStatic; infer_instance

/-- The derived `issue` (question 1, `issue_as_kernel_split`): `split` of `internal` on `r`, then
`store` of the block into `dst`. -/
def IssueSeq (k : K) (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  SplitPre k s st.internal [r] ∧ StorePre (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) s.A.length dst

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (st : Stack)
    (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueSeq k s st r dst) := by
  unfold IssueSeq; infer_instance

/-- Arrival state of the derived `issue`. -/
def issueSeqEff (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  storeEff (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) s.A.length dst

/-- The derived `reset` on the cells above `m` (question 1, `reset_as_kernel`): `split` of
`internal` on them, then `release` of the derived authority. -/
def RewindSeq (k : K) (s : S3) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
  SplitPre k s st.internal [above st m] ∧
    ReleasePre (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena (above st m))) s.A.length

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) :
    Decidable (RewindSeq k s st m) := by
  unfold RewindSeq; infer_instance

/-- The guard of §56 for `internal` `i`: no live arena and no live stack already uses it. -/
def Guard56 (d : DS) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ ar ∈ d.s.arenas, d.s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ i) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ d.stacks, d.s.Active x.internal → x.internal ≠ i

instance (d : DS) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 d i) := by unfold Guard56; infer_instance

section Ops
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- Creation of a stack on `storage` administered by `internal` (as O17, §76): the preconditions of
  | push (j size dst : Nat)
  | mark (j : Nat)
  | rewind (j : Nat) (m : Mark)
  | grow (j b extra : Nat)

/-- The guard of §56 that a kernel `newArena` adds in the library: the registry of the stacks. -/
def KGuard (d : DS) : Op → Prop
  | .newArena _ i => ∀ x ∈ d.stacks, d.s.Active x.internal → x.internal ≠ i
  | _ => True

instance (d : DS) (o : Op) : Decidable (KGuard d o) := by
  cases o <;> unfold KGuard <;> infer_instance

/-- A step of the library. A kernel `newArena` also consults the registry of the stacks (§56). -/
def dexec (d : DS) : DOp → Out
  | .kernel o =>
    if KGuard d o then
      match kexec k d.s o with
      | some s' => .ok { d with s := s' }
      | none => .reject
    else .reject
  | .newStack st i => DataStack.newStack d st i
  | .push j size dst => DataStack.push k d j size dst

## 7. Registre de la reconstruction de référence

0. Exécution de MM2-H (17 cas) contre la reconstruction de MM-02 ; MM23-H15 et H16 rejoués après application des décisions 2 et 3 du jalon 2.
1. Écarts du brouillon MM-03 trouvés au jalon 2 (passe 1, (f) 1–6) : utilisabilité des feuilles lues et écrites ; empreintes faites de feuilles ; une racine par `alloc` ; marques de mort transitives ; `RootLive` ; bonne fondation des chaînes de possession.
2. Locaux d'`enterFrame` possédés directement par le cadre (O6, à écrire dans la v0.3).
3. Décisions 1 à 4 du jalon 2 : disjonction déclarée par feuilles ; pointeur d'une région vide ; adresse la plus basse ; feuille de référence de la taille d'un pointeur.
4. Théorèmes à énoncer : induction « toute feuille `Init` atteinte a été déclarée ou écrite » ; correspondance `Step` ↔ `Reachable`.
5. Noms Lean des textes normatifs déplacés en annexe de correspondance.

### MM-03.3.8 — Arènes `𝓡`

Chaque entrée possède les champs suivants :

```text
ArenaEntry {
    storage: PlaceId
    internal: AuthorityId
    available: Set<Region>
    issued: Set<(Region, AuthorityId)>
}
```

L'arène est **vivante** si `internal` est active. La **valeur arène** est l'emplacement détenteur de `internal`, distinct du propriétaire éventuel de `storage`. Le stockage administré peut être local, statique, alloué ou issu d'une autre arène, sous les préconditions de `newArena` et les invariants applicables. `available` et `issued` restent bien **dans l'entrée d'arène**.

### MM-03.3.9 — État initial `S3.init statics`

### 2.7 — `ArenaInv`

Pour chaque arène vivante :

- `storage` désigne un emplacement existant et utilisable ; l'empreinte de `internal` est exactement celle de `storage` ;
- `internal` est active, de mode propre `Modify`, détenue par la valeur arène ;
- les régions disponibles et les régions émises appartiennent au stockage administré ;
- deux émissions encore actives ont des régions disjointes ; une région encore émise n'appartient pas simultanément aux régions disponibles ;
- chaque autorité de bloc encore émis est une dérivée de `internal` conforme aux règles d'exclusivité et de validité ;
- les restrictions d'ancrage et de possession sont respectées.

Les entrées d'arène ne constituent pas, à elles seules, un propriétaire supplémentaire de stockage. Deux arènes vivantes peuvent couvrir des feuilles communes lorsque leurs autorités `internal` sont distinctes et que leurs droits effectifs sont compatibles ; aucune disjonction **globale** des empreintes d'arènes n'est imposée.

### 2.7 bis — Administration unifiée des abstractions vivantes

**Une identité d’autorité peut être `internal` d’au plus une abstraction d’administration vivante**, qu’il s’agisse d’une entrée d’arène ou d’une instance d’administration de bibliothèque (notamment `HandlePool`). Avant d’inscrire une nouvelle abstraction, `newArena` et toute opération analogue de bibliothèque doivent vérifier conjointement l’absence de cette identité dans **les deux registres des abstractions vivantes**. L’unicité porte sur l’identité de l’autorité `internal`, non sur la seule intersection éventuelle des empreintes : des abstractions ayant des `internal` distincts ne sont pas interdites du seul fait que leurs empreintes se chevauchent. Les contrats de bibliothèque doivent mettre les informations nécessaires à cette garde à disposition de l’opération de création ; il ne suffit pas de contrôler son propre registre isolément.

Cette garde n’ajoute ni une permission ni une allocation, et n’introduit pas un mécanisme général de détection des cycles d’autorités. La représentation physique et l’encapsulation des registres des bibliothèques restent extérieures à ce noyau.

### 2.8 — Invariant principal et obligations spécialisées
## 6. Arènes : instance de la discipline d'accès

Une arène n'est pas un second système d'allocation indépendant de la discipline des autorités. Elle est une instance construite avec une autorité interne `Modify`, un stockage existant, des régions disponibles et des régions déjà émises. La **valeur arène** tient l'autorité interne ; elle n'a pas nécessairement la propriété physique du stockage administré. Les métadonnées d'administration sont soumises aux mêmes obligations d'accès que les autres valeurs, sous le contrat de mutation partagée lorsqu'il s'applique.

**`MetaRight(s,ar)`** désigne le droit légal de mettre à jour les métadonnées de l'arène : accès de modification exercisable sur la valeur arène, ou discipline `writeShared` valide sur les feuilles de métadonnées déclarées `SharedMutable`. Cette abstraction ne dispense pas de justifier l'accès effectif requis par l'opération.

### O17 — `newArena(storage, internal)`

**Préconditions**

1. `storage` est un emplacement existant, utilisable, sous `Modify` exerçable par le cadre courant. Il peut être local, statique, alloué ou être un bloc issu d'une arène précédente.
2. `internal` est nommée explicitement par l'appelant, existe, est active, de mode propre `Modify` et `ExercisableAt(s,internal,Modify)` est vrai.
3. `internal` est **détenue par un emplacement** : cet emplacement est la valeur arène ; `footprint(internal) = footprint(storage)`.
4. **Garde d’administration unifiée (2.7 bis) :** aucune abstraction d’administration **vivante**, qu’elle soit une arène ou une instance de bibliothèque telle qu’un pool de handles, n’utilise déjà cette identité `internal`. Les registres d’arènes **et** des instances de bibliothèque sont consultés avant l’inscription. Deux identités distinctes peuvent couvrir des feuilles communes : ce n’est pas en soi une cause de rejet.
5. Toutes les feuilles de la valeur arène qui détient `internal` sont déjà `Init` (`LeavesInit`) ; la construction ne les initialise pas implicitement.
6. Les relations de dépendance, de détenteur, de stockage et d'administration respectent `WF3`, I1, `AnchorOrder`, `AnchorOrderHeld` et les invariants d'arène attendus.

**Effet `ok`** : ajout d'une entrée vivante `{storage, internal, available, issued}` ; l'ensemble `available` initial représente le stockage administré, `issued` est initialement vide. Aucun emplacement, droit d'accès ou état `Init` n'est fabriqué par l'inscription de l'entrée. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

L'identité de `internal` et non l'indice de `storage` est la clé de non-duplication des arènes vivantes. Il n'existe pas de contrainte globale imposant que des arènes vivantes aient des empreintes deux à deux disjointes.

### O18 — `issue(arena, region, destination)`

**Préconditions statiques**

1. L'entrée `arena` existe et est vivante ; `internal` est active. La valeur arène peut être légalement administrée (`MetaRight`).
2. `region` appartient au stockage administré ; `destination` est une **feuille** utilisable, non `Init` (elle peut notamment être `Uninit` ou `Moved`), ne détenant aucune autorité active ; la destination peut légalement recevoir la valeur du bloc au mode `Modify`.
   **Prévention locale de l’auto-blocage (option 2) : la feuille `destination` n’appartient pas à `region`, y compris lorsque la région est déclarée disponible.** Cette condition est statique et est vérifiée avant le `fail` de disponibilité.
3. Les restrictions **statiques** de validité et de non-échappement applicables à la destination sont satisfaites. Le contrôle de `AnchorOrder` qui dépend de la nouvelle ancre est effectué sur **l’état d’arrivée simulé**, après la vérification de disponibilité décrite au point 4 ; il ne peut transformer une émission indisponible (`fail`) en `reject`.

**Contrôle de disponibilité et d'exercice**

4. Si les conditions statiques tiennent mais que `region` n'appartient plus à `available`, l'opération produit **`fail` et laisse tout l'état inchangé**. Une région indisponible n'autorise pas à contourner un rejet statique préalable.
5. Si la région est disponible, le mode effectif de `internal` sur cette région doit permettre `Modify` ; à défaut, l'issue est `reject` (`noRight`). La région ne peut chevaucher une région émise encore active.
6. Le résultat simulé doit respecter `AnchorOrderHeld` **dans l'état d'arrivée** ; une émission vers une valeur plus durable qu'une ancre locale ne devient pas valide du seul fait qu'elle est stockée chez l'appelant.

**Effet `ok`** : une autorité de bloc d'identité fraîche, dérivée de `internal` et de mode `Modify`, est émise pour la région ; elle est détenue par `destination`, qui reçoit l'ancre correspondante. La région quitte `available` et est ajoutée à `issued` avec son autorité. **Seule la feuille `destination` passe à `Init`** ; aucune autre feuille de la valeur arène ne change d'initialisation. Les émissions antérieures restent intactes et valides. Une émission n'installe pas automatiquement des ancres sur des valeurs tierces : celles-ci doivent utiliser leurs mécanismes légaux de dépendance.

**Issues :** `ok`, `fail` (région indisponible après validation statique), `reject` (règle statique, droit effectif ou ancrage non respecté). La destination peut être une feuille de la valeur arène elle-même : son initialisation constitue alors **l'écriture explicite de cette destination**, et non une initialisation implicite des métadonnées de toute la valeur arène.

### O19 — `reset(arena)`

**Préconditions**

1. L’entrée existe et est vivante. La mise à jour des métadonnées de l’arène est autorisée par **`MetaRight(s,arena)`** : `Modify` exerçable sur la valeur arène **ou** mutation `writeShared` légale sur ses métadonnées `SharedMutable`. L’autorité `internal` et les autres restrictions de l’arène restent valides.
2. Aucune autorité dérivée de `internal` ne reste active : aucune émission vivante ni dérivée subsistante ne peut être invalidée par ce `reset`.
3. Aucun emplacement encore utilisable ne dépend, directement ou transitivement, d'une ancre située dans le sous-arbre d'origines de `internal`. Les obligations de validité d'autres arènes imbriquées restent satisfaites.

**Effet `ok`** : la totalité des régions du stockage administré redevient disponible et la liste des émissions est vidée, sous le contrat de l'arène. Les anciennes autorités émises ne peuvent plus être utilisées, car les préconditions excluaient leur activité. **Aucune feuille n'est rendue `Init` par `reset`**, y compris dans la valeur arène. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

La réutilisation sûre après `reset` exige que les anciennes émissions et leurs dépendants actifs aient effectivement cessé d'exister. Une région historiquement émise ne reste pas définitivement indisponible pour cette seule raison.

# Annexe F — Registre de reconstruction de référence (non normatif)

La reconstruction de référence doit repartir du texte **validé**, et non des approximations du brouillon. Les éléments suivants ne sont pas tous prouvés à ce stade :

1. **Six écarts du brouillon MM-03** (`MM23_v0.1.md`, section (f)) : (i) feuilles lues/écrites utilisables, (ii) empreintes composées uniquement de feuilles, (iii) `alloc` créant une racine unique, (iv) marques de mort transitives après `free` et `endUse`, (v) `RootLive`/`RootHeld`, (vi) bonne fondation des chaînes de possession.
2. **Locaux de `enterFrame`** : rendre explicite que les locaux créés par l'opération sont possédés directement par le cadre ; une forme de local ayant pour propriétaire un autre local n'est pas une forme de `enterFrame` admise.
3. **Jalon 2 — décisions 1 à 4** : (i) disjonction déclarée des **feuilles**, à justifier par la bibliothèque, puis disjonction des plages d'octets sous `LayoutWF` ; (ii) adresse/provenance d'une région vide = base/allocation de son ancre effective ; (iii) pour une région non vide, adresse minimale des feuilles de taille non nulle, sans confondre pointeur et représentation d'une région non contiguë ; (iv) feuille recevant une référence de taille exactement adaptée au pointeur et `decode` lisant uniquement ces octets (obligations Specs 4/11).
4. **Jalon 2 — autres points** : `SameSizeAlong` demeure à la Spec 4, `Repr` inclut `MM02.WF`, `freeSound_derived` et fournisseur conservé, simulation conditionnelle à paramètres fixés ; ne pas présenter le théorème de simulation comme une validation autonome de tous les contenus binaires.
5. **Induction d'initialisation** : toute feuille `Init` atteinte l'était à l'état initial ou provient d'une écriture autorisée, d'un transfert légal ou d'une émission écrivant explicitement sa destination. **Correspondance `Step` / `Reachable`** : démontrer la liaison des constructeurs et transitions opérationnelles générales, non seulement les cas isolés.
6. **Reconstruction `HandlePool`** : réénoncer et prouver `PoolInv` corrigé ; prouver l'effet de `freeSlot` sous `MetaRight`, notamment lorsque seul `writeShared` autorise la mutation des métadonnées ; vérifier `resolveMany Observe`, les deux registres et le stockage `Uninit` de `newPool` ; vérifier la propriété d'exclusivité à travers toutes les opérations du noyau.
7. **Corpus MM2-H** : exécuter les 17 identifiants d'origine (H13 scindé en H13a/H13b, donc 18 scénarios) sur la reconstruction de référence, et non sur le vieux brouillon ; conserver les cas de formation d'adresse et reconstruction de pointeur non tranchés par MM-02.G comme obligations, sans les décréter réussis.
8. **MM23-H15/H16** : enregistrer et corriger les écarts connus de pointeurs vides/ordre des feuilles, sans les présenter comme des preuves déjà acquises.
9. **Option 2 `NoLock`** : reconstruire et vérifier la nouvelle précondition locale de O4 et O18 ; H49 et H51 restent des limites d'ergonomie (cycles d'autorités, non UB) ; l'option 3 globale n'est pas adoptée.
10. **Appels** : enregistrer la primitive de `sink` à l'entrée d'appel et les conditions du ré-emprunt H01 pour la Spec 3, sans les introduire silencieusement dans les transitions courantes de MM-03.

La reconstruction utilisera un journal de traçabilité clause → définition → théorème → cas, et distinguera l'ensemble des garanties effectivement prouvées des conditions de programme bien typé, d'ABI et de bibliothèque.

231:17. W1–W3 reçoivent la classe Lib (pool et arène) ; le matériel ne classe pas les scénarios du §5b.
249:3. **Deux pools sur le même `internal`.** `newPool` ne l'interdit pas (clause 4 de `newArena` lue à la lettre ; `pool_two_on_one_internal`). Le handle d'un pool résout alors une entrée que l'autre a libérée et réallouée, et un `freeSlot` de l'un termine le contenu d'une entrée vivante de l'autre (`pool_two_freeSlot_cross`). Symétriquement, `newArena` accepte l'`internal` d'un pool vivant (`arena_on_pool_internal`).

253:7. **W3.** Les blocs sont-ils émis vers des locaux, auquel cas `reset` reste rejeté après `endUse` de la structure, ou dans la structure ?

def it0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0),
